name: factory-panel
description: Panes beside the chat for running an Agent IX factory: machines, named focuses, an escalations inbox, ix-relay announcements, and team health.

prometheusUrl.description: Prometheus the panes query. Leave empty to use the shared ix config (observability.prometheusUrl), else this host's relay endpoint, else http://prometheus.luna.ix
prometheusUrl.title: Prometheus URL

grafanaUrl.description: Grafana, for the panes' dashboard links. Leave empty to use ix config observability.grafanaUrl, else derived from Prometheus's address
grafanaUrl.title: Grafana URL

teams.description: Comma-separated herdr workspace labels ix-board should report on
teams.title: ix-board teams

refreshSeconds.description: How often Prometheus and herdr are polled
refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)

role.description: Which role this session plays: coordinator, code-lead, planner, worker, or auto (read from the relay address, else asked once with /factory; a code lead until answered)
role.title: Role

bandModules.description: Comma list that replaces the role preset: health, local, focus, queue, lead, lanes, attention, relay, team, agents, spend
bandModules.title: Band modules

bandFocus.description: Focus the band bar follows: a coordinator address or part of its summary (default: the first)
bandFocus.title: Band focus

inlineView.description: What a classic-layout session shows above the prompt: band, status or off
inlineView.title: Non-fullscreen view
